facts.business: Singer India Limited manufactures and sells sewing products under the SINGER and MERRITT brands and home appliances including kitchen appliances, fans, room coolers, irons, heaters, and washing machines under the SINGER brand.
key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to pressure to achieve performance targets
Regulatory risk from evolving Quality Control Orders (QCOs) and BIS certification requirements
Pricing disruptions from BEE rating transitions in fans segment
